items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: B.C. Canard was one of the greatest I've heard in many years

ctx.x: All the work I can get, Herman is right there with me. I can't seem to get enough to please him. Oh, one of the really, great, great alto players who probably is not so well known outside of Kansas City but whom we have listened to and played with and who passed in 1967, one of the greatest I've ever heard is B.C. Canard. What would you
like to say about B.C. Canard? B.C. Canard was one of the greatest I've heard in many years and you don't hear that -- with the tone and everything and --
Didn't he go -- as I remember, you know Ben, who's been with me for 12 years, his brother, younger brother --
